Independent Lucida runtime staging. Official onnxruntime-web 1.30.0, MIT. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web/v/1.30.0 . JavaScript and WASM assets are unmodified; the native asyncify WASM is split into two byte-exact <=20MiB chunks with the original assembled SHA256 recorded in asyncify-manifest.json. Ordinary WASM and GPU bundles are the same upstream version. LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt are retained. Existing production vendor/ort is not modified.
